Author: Taurenkey (Puni.sh)
Name: Artisan (XivHub fork)
Punchline: Crafting automation. This fork adds saved FC Workshop presets and fixes under-crafted intermediates.
Description: Crafting lists, macros and automation. This XivHub fork improves FC Workshop crafting: you can add parts or phases to the open list and save workshop presets. It also fixes intermediates being under-crafted, the craft order, and progress and ETA when steps are skipped.
ChangeLog:
- Added the Artisan.CreateList IPC: other plugins can create a crafting list from item ids and quantities.
- Added the Artisan.CreateListWithSubcrafts IPC: like Artisan.CreateList, and also adds every intermediate craft.
- Fixed IPC teardown unregistering several providers with the wrong types.
- Fixed quick synth crafting 0 of an intermediate under "Skip items you already have enough of" when the list quantity already excludes owned stock, which then failed every craft that uses it.
- Added the Artisan.ImportList IPC: other plugins can import a crafting list from Artisan export JSON, keeping its skip settings and each item's Quick Synthesis choice.
- List rows set to quick synthesis that cannot be quick-synthesized craft with progress only, so they come out NQ, without waiting for a Raphael solution first.
- Synced with upstream: premade lists can be copied into your own lists, and exporting a premade list works.
- Lists that skip up to the list amount share HQ ingredients across the crafts of the rows they are for, instead of using them all on the first ones; other rows use NQ ingredients first.
- Synced with upstream: Gather & Chill integration in lists, faster list ingredient tables.
- Synced with upstream: native Craft All and list buttons on the recipe window, fixed native button scaling.
